title.en: Wafer edges: focus rings age too

body.zh: 新环/ 高度匹配；鞘层较平直，离子近垂直入射，边缘刻蚀可控；等离子体；离子入射；鞘层；较平直；晶圆；聚焦环；（新）
body.en: New ring / matched height A flatter sheath gives nearly normal ion incidence and controlled edge etching Plasma Ion incidence Sheath relatively flat Wafer Focus ring (new)

body.zh: 老化环/高度失配；鞘层弯曲，离子入射角变化，边缘刻蚀易异常；等离子体；离子入射；鞘层；发生弯曲；晶圆；聚焦环；（老化）
body.en: Aged ring / height mismatch The sheath bends, ion angles change and edge etching becomes abnormal Plasma Ion incidence Sheath bends Wafer Focus ring (aged)

body.zh: 聚焦环高度；决定鞘层形状与边缘电场
body.en: Focus-ring height Determine sheath shape and edge electric field

body.zh: 晶圆—环间隙；影响鞘层耦合与离子角度
body.en: Wafer-to-ring gap Affect sheath coupling and ion angle

body.zh: 材料与介电性质；导电 /绝缘；二次电子发射；表面状态；影响鞘层分布与刻蚀选择性
body.en: Material and dielectric properties Conductive / insulating Secondary-electron emission Surface condition Affect sheath distribution and etch selectivity

body.zh: 环温度与使用寿命；改变侵蚀速率并随寿命漂移
body.en: Ring temperature and lifetime Change erosion rate, which drifts with lifetime

body.zh: 边缘补偿 ↔ 聚焦环侵蚀与颗粒风险
body.en: Edge compensation ↔ focus-ring erosion and particle risk

body.zh: 量测反馈：边缘CD与深度/截面/ 环厚度与寿命
body.en: Metrology feedback: edge CD and depth / cross section / ring thickness and lifetime
